title: Tour: App Marketplace
blurb: Add extra apps and connections to your Luubu account.

steps.title: Open App Marketplace
steps.body: Click **App Marketplace** in the left menu. Extra apps and connections live here.

steps.title: Browse
steps.body: Scroll through apps or browse by category.

steps.title: Search
steps.body: Know what you want? Search by name, like Xero or Zapier.

steps.title: App details
steps.body: Click an app to see what it does, what it costs and what it can access.
steps.tip: Can't find or install an app? Some need us to add them for you. Ask us to switch this on: hello@luubu.com

steps.title: Installed apps
steps.body: The **Installed** tab lists apps already added to your account.

steps.title: What's next
steps.body: Next: try **Find and install an app** from the Guide.
